summary: loop_attach_hosttest.c, a loop attachment while a writer moves the file, with a fault in a private copy of rach2/sys/block/loop.c

argv:
set -eu
t=${WORK}/tree
sh tests/proofs/tree.sh "$t" ${SRC} rach2/sys tests/host
cd "$t"
s=rach2/sys
exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -Wno-pointer-to-int-cast -Wno-int-to-pointer-cast -ffreestanding -I $s -I $s/lib -I $s/proc tests/host/loop_attach_hosttest.c $s/block/chain.c $s/lib/kstring.c $s/lib/kctypes.c -o ${WORK}/loop_attach_hosttest

faults.name: stale-resolution
faults.summary: a loop_resolve that takes the namespace lock after its one walk and opens the node that walk found

lines: loop-attach-hosttest: fail: loop read avoids the reused old extent
